name: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd

profile.what: Designs and assembles wiring harnesses (the vehicle's electrical 'nervous system': wires, terminals, connectors, junction boxes, tubes and grommets) and harness components for Indian vehicle makers: passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, two-wheelers, tractors and off-road machines. Low-voltage and high-voltage (EV) harnesses; design and validation partner for new models. Domestic only (exports negligible).

customers.note: AR FY26 note 34 (Ind AS 108): customers with 10% or more of revenue, not named. Customer 1 is 41% of FY26 revenue (39% in FY25); Customer 2 is 16% (12%). Emkay calls Maruti Suzuki (MSIL) the 'key client'. Hyundai and Kia are served by another SAMIL JV company, not by MSWIL (q4deck p4).
customers.top10: Supplies 9 of the 10 best-selling passenger-vehicle models in India in FY26 (q4deck p4)

plants.src: AR FY26 BRSR section A, Rule 5 disclosure; q4deck p5

profile.marketShare: Over 40% of the Indian wiring-harness market (Screener company profile, citing the company); no FY26 figure in the AR. Treat as approximate.
profile.jv: Joint venture of Samvardhana Motherson International (SAMIL, 33.43%) and Sumitomo Wiring Systems (SWS, 25.10%; with affiliates 25.34%), plus the Sehgal family (~3%). SWS is a 100% subsidiary of Sumitomo Electric Industries, Japan. SAMIL supplies wires, terminals, connectors, PVC tubes and rubber parts, and EV components; SWS supplies child parts and technology (AR FY26 MD&A p66-70).

guidance.capex: FY27 capex ~Rs200 cr, similar to FY26 (Q4 call); funded from internal accruals (Q1 call). Mix: new capacity for customers' expansions, automation and digitisation, replacement.
guidance.expansion: Existing plants ~80% utilised; policy is to expand at 80%, only against firm customer orders. 'In the next few quarters, you will hear us for that [new expansion plans]' (COO, Q1 call).
guidance.copper: Pass-through with a 3-6 month lag; most customers on a three-month reset, a few on six months; currency also passed through back-to-back. Discussions to shorten the lag ('that's the direction'), no change by Aug-2026.
guidance.wages: Minimum wages in the NCR region rose 35-40% (unanticipated); fully in Q1FY27 numbers; recovery from customers under negotiation, no timeline ('nobody can predict exactly the timeline').
guidance.greenfields: Three greenfields (Kharkhoda ICE ~80%, Navagam/Gujarat EV+ICE ~60%, Pune EV+ICE ~50%: a customer postponed a model) run at ~Rs450 cr a quarter, breakeven ex copper lag; ~Rs2,000 cr a year at full capacity; to contribute to profit 'in one or two quarters' (Q1 call). Pathredi (EV+ICE) SOP Q4FY26; Chennai (EV) volumes delayed.
guidance.margin: No margin guidance: 'we are a ROCE-focused company, idea is to have it more than 40%' (COO, Q1 call). After cost recovery 'the ratio becomes a bit different' (denominator effect), then improve via localisation (Q1 call).
guidance.architecture: Zonal/48V architectures: no de-contenting seen in India; content keeps rising with features; MSWIL is design partner for future models of a Japanese OEM (Q1 call).

history: Motherson Sumi Systems (MSSL) formed as a JV of the Sehgal family and Sumitomo Wiring Systems to make wiring harnesses in India
MSWIL incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary of SAMIL (then MSSL)
Appointed date: SAMIL's domestic wiring-harness (DWH) business demerged into MSWIL; FY21 DWH revenue Rs3,938 cr
SAMIL shareholders receive one MSWIL share for each SAMIL share (record date 17-Jan-2022)
Bonus issue 2:5 (126.3 cr shares); share count 315.8 cr to 442.1 cr
Three greenfields (Kharkhoda, Navagam, Pune) plus Pathredi and Chennai; greenfield revenue Rs1,040 cr in FY26
Bonus issue 1:2 (221.1 cr shares); share count 663.2 cr
ESOP 2025 approved: up to 1.55 cr options, shares bought in the market through a trust (no dilution)
